$themes.name: Light
$themes.$description: The light surface: every captured fable.co page paints the :root semantic layer — a white catalog field, cream/pearl marketing sections and deep forest bands; there is no user theme toggle.

$themes.name: Dark
$themes.$description: The scoped dark surface: fable.co's stylesheet redeclares the semantic layer under a .dark class for dark reading/detail views (with module-scoped twins like ListDetailView's lightOnDark); no captured public page paints it, so values resolve the declared .dark var() chains, and the measured footer/discover dark surfaces are recorded as roles.
